prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and caused early stops.
Home wait_info changes (12 tests) were helpful in four winning tests, though eight showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (2 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), finish copy changes (3 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with only one test or conflicting results across tests.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Status Feed: Add a live rendering activity feed component on the waiting screen to inform users of pet generation progress. (why: Home wait time has a high mean of 2336s and median 201s; previous wait_info additions on home showed strong retention gains.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Journey Carousel Layout: Redesign the story intro screen to use a carousel layout highlighting companion desktop features prior to path selection. (why: Choose path step shows long mean duration (514s) and 20.6% drop-off; dynamic intro visuals increase intent.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Selection Account Auth Flow: Move sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and customization steps right before desktop launch waiting. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users upfront before they experience pet customization; reordering leverages commitment.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Stage Spotlight Layout: Redesign the friend picker screen with a spotlight layout highlighting pet personalities and traits. (why: Adoption stage drops 29.1% of users with high mean duration of 1017s; cleaner visual spotlight speeds selection.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Activity Timer Stream: Include a countdown timer and active tips delay display on the home waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Long home wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause anxiety; explicit timing info reduces drop-off.)
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Launch View: Redesign the final home intro screen using a spotlight layout showing essential desktop tray and visibility controls. (why: Support receives multiple emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Stage Card Grid View: Reconfigure the choose_path screen into a stage layout with distinct visual option cards. (why: 20.6% of users drop off at choose_path with a median time of 8s but mean of 514s.)
7: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Stage Layout Overhaul: Change the photo upload screen layout to split view to clearly display pet reference images side-by-side with recommendations. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures and rendering issues.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Keybindings Copy Focus: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explicitly explain pet tray controls and visibility shortcuts. (why: 3 support tickets specifically cited post-onboarding confusion over hiding and controlling the desktop pet.)
9: [home, new_flow] Desktop Generation Progress Notification Stream: Enable desktop arrival notifications and progress tracking on the waiting screen to keep users informed during long setup. (why: Home conversion step drop-off and high mean waiting times (2336s) benefit from active setup progress notifications.)

Wait_info on home step addresses long wait times and consistently performs well.
Support emails confirm issue, but past finish redesigns showed no positive impact.

Addresses support complaints; adoption layout had +2.3% gain but on 1 test only.
